root_cause: CurveController and CurveEllipse use ordinary openTransaction, which clears prior native Redo on publication attempts.
After native observers mutate Shape/Placement/construction/result/units/parent, the ordinary commit path does not compare complete actual output to immutable expected evidence.
The result handler clears units/source/document state after commit or cancels after error without binding that cleanup to the original generation; a restarted same-command session can be erased.
